info.title: roadbeat Studio API — Publishing & Distribution
info.description:
Self-hosted headless CMS — Content Management & Publishing API

**Publishing & Distribution.** Publishing to discovery nodes and content pods, the public Delivery API, exports and outgoing webhooks.

post.summary: Create a full backup
post.description: Creates a ZIP archive of content, content types, assets metadata, and organization settings.

201.description: The completed Backup record — the archive is written synchronously, so `status` is already `completed` (or the request fails).

get.summary: List all backups and content pods

200.description: Every Backup row of the organization, newest first — both `full` backups and generated `content_pod` archives.

get.summary: Get backup status

200.description: The Backup record.

delete.summary: Delete backup and its archive file

200.description: The Backup row and its stored archive were removed.

get.summary: Download backup archive (ZIP)

200.description: Success. JSON responses are wrapped in the standard envelope: `{ "data": ... }`, with optional `meta` (e.g. pagination) on list endpoints.

meta.description: Optional metadata (pagination, counts) — present on list endpoints

post.summary: Restore from backup
post.description: Restores content, content types, assets metadata, and/or settings from a completed backup.

200.description: Counts of records written per category.

post.summary: Verify backup integrity (dry-run)
post.description: Verifies the archive checksum, manifest, required files, item counts, and content-type references without mutating any data. Returns a structured pass/fail report (IMP-OPS-11).

200.description: The verification report. Always 200 — a failed archive is reported via `ok: false` plus `errors`, not an HTTP error.

get.summary: Get export progress for an in-progress backup

200.description: The in-memory progress record. `data` is `null` when no export for this ID is being tracked (finished long ago, or the process restarted).

post.summary: Validate a backup archive before importing
post.description: Checks manifest, counts items, and detects conflicts with existing data.

200.description: What the uploaded archive contains and which records would collide with existing data. Nothing is written.

post.summary: Import data from a backup archive with conflict resolution
post.description: Imports content, content types, assets metadata, and settings. Supports skip, overwrite, and merge strategies for conflicts.

200.description: Counts of records actually written after the conflict strategy was applied.

post.summary: Generate a Content Pod
post.description: Creates a portable archive of published content with JSON files, manifest, and HTML index.

201.description: Summary of the generated pod. Download it via `GET /export/backups/{backupId}/download`.

get.summary: Get Content Pod configuration for the organization

200.description: The Content Pod configuration, or `data: null` when the organization has not configured a pod yet.

post.summary: Create Content Pod configuration

201.description: The created configuration with tier quotas and derived base URL. Returns 409 when a pod is already configured.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

200.description: The updated configuration. `baseUrl` is recalculated whenever `podMode` or `subdomain` changes.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: Test Content Pod server connectivity

200.description: Result of a HEAD probe against the pod base URL. Always 200 — an unreachable server is reported via `reachable: false`.

get.summary: Get Content Pod publishing status (manifest, stats)

200.description: Pod configuration summary plus live manifest entry count. When no pod is configured only `configured: false` is returned.

get.summary: Verify the pod manifest signature (IMP-OPS-14)
get.description: Checks the manifest digest + Ed25519 signature against the signing publisher key. The same check an offline re-hosting party performs.

200.description: The verification verdict. Always 200 — a bad or missing signature is reported via `ok: false` plus `reason`.

post.summary: Publish a content item to the Content Pod

200.description: Bundle URLs, checksum and size of the item written to the pod.

post.summary: Unpublish a content item from the Content Pod

200.description: The item was removed from the pod and the manifest re-signed.

post.summary: Publish all published content to the Content Pod

200.description: Bulk publish summary with a per-item outcome for every published content item.

get.summary: List all content items published to the pod manifest

200.description: The manifest entries read from the pod filesystem, each with its absolute pod URL.

get.summary: Preview the Content Pod bundle for a content item (without publishing)

200.description: The bundle exactly as it would be written to the pod. Nothing is persisted.

get.summary: List pod items whose content no longer exists (nothing is changed)

200.description: Items still published in the pod although their content was deleted in Studio.

post.summary: Remove the pod items whose content no longer exists

200.description: Number and ids of the removed items.

post.summary: Set up a free roadbeat-hosted pod (static or dynamic)

201.description: The provisioned pod: config, signing key and — when the Federation Gateway is reachable — the auto-created ActivityPub actor.

post.summary: Set up a self-hosted pod (own storage)

201.description: The provisioned self-hosted pod (tier `starter`), optionally with a custom domain.

post.summary: Switch pod between static and dynamic modes

201.description: Previous and current mode plus the recalculated base URL. Returns 400 when the pod is already in the requested mode.

post.summary: Deploy dynamic feature scripts to the pod

201.description: Which dynamic features were deployed. Returns 400 for static pods. Deployment problems are reported non-fatally via `deployed: false`.

get.summary: Check Pod Hosting API connectivity

200.description: Reachability of the upstream Pod Hosting API. Always 200 — an unreachable service is reported via `reachable: false`.

get.summary: Get the pod details for the current organization

200.description: The upstream pod record, resolved from the organization Content Pod subdomain (created on the fly if it did not exist yet).

get.summary: Get storage usage for the organization pod

200.description: Quota, consumption and item count as reported by the Pod Hosting API.

get.summary: List all content published to the pod

200.description: Content entries the Pod Hosting API has stored for this pod.

delete.summary: Remove a content item from the pod

post.summary: Set up a custom domain for the pod

201.description: The pending verification record plus the TXT and CNAME records that must be created before verification can succeed.

delete.summary: Remove custom domain from the pod

post.summary: Verify custom domain DNS records

201.description: The verification record after the DNS check. On success the domain is attached to the pod. Returns 400 when no verification is pending.

get.summary: List webhooks (CE: max 3)

200.description: A page of the organization's webhooks.

post.summary: Create webhook (CE: max 3 endpoints)

201.description: The created webhook, including its freshly generated signing secret.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: List dead-lettered deliveries (exhausted retries) — ?status=unresolved

200.description: Dead-lettered deliveries with their total. Pagination lives inside `data` (`items`/`total`), not in a `meta` block.

post.summary: Re-enqueue a dead-lettered delivery (same idempotency key)

200.description: The dead-letter entry was re-enqueued and marked `replayed`.

post.summary: Dismiss a dead-lettered delivery without replaying

200.description: The dead-letter entry was marked `dismissed`.

get.summary: Get webhook by ID with recent delivery log

200.description: The webhook with its 10 most recent delivery attempts.
The updated webhook.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

200.description: The webhook and its delivery log were deleted.

post.summary: Send a test payload to the webhook endpoint

200.description: Outcome of the synchronous `webhook.test` delivery. Returns 200 even when the receiver failed — inspect `success`.

post.summary: Rotate the webhook signing secret (previous secret stays valid during the rotation window)

200.description: The new secret plus the prior one that keeps verifying during the overlap window.

post.summary: Replay a past delivery — same X-Idempotency-Key, re-enqueued (IMP-API-10)

200.description: The delivery was re-enqueued with its original receiver-facing idempotency key.

get.summary: List a webhook's deliveries (optionally ?status=failed)

200.description: Delivery attempts, newest first (default 50, max 200).

get.summary: List all discovery nodes with pagination

200.description: A page of the organization's Discovery Nodes, highest priority first.

get.summary: Get discovery node by ID with publish statistics

200.description: The node enriched with publish-record counts per status.

put.summary: Create or update a discovery node (upsert by ID)

200.description: The created or updated node (200 in both cases — this is an idempotent upsert).

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

delete.summary: Delete a discovery node (fails if content is published to it)

200.description: The node was deleted. Returns 409 while content is still published to it.

post.summary: Enable a discovery node

200.description: The node with `enabled: true`.

post.summary: Disable a discovery node

200.description: The node with `enabled: false`.

post.summary: Distribute a published content item to all applicable Discovery Nodes

200.description: Per-node publish outcome for every applicable Discovery Node.

post.summary: Withdraw (unpublish) a content item from all Discovery Nodes

200.description: Per-node unpublish outcome.

post.summary: Retry a failed publish to a specific Discovery Node

200.description: Outcome of the retried publish.

get.summary: Get publish status for a content item across all Discovery Nodes

200.description: One record per Discovery Node the content was ever published to, newest first; empty array when never published.

get.summary: Preview the teaser that would be generated for a content item (without publishing)

200.description: The teaser exactly as it would be sent to Discovery Nodes.

post.summary: Backfill x-filter metadata fields into existing news content (non-destructive, preserves all existing data)

200.description: Counts of patched and already-current items.

post.summary: Republish all published content to Discovery Nodes (regenerates teasers with type_filters)

200.description: Bulk republish summary with per-item results.

post.summary: Republish all content to ONE Discovery Node (post-recovery backfill; resets its circuit breaker)

200.description: Backfill summary for the targeted node.

get.summary: List publisher key pairs (public keys only; private keys never exposed)

200.description: All key pairs of the organization, newest first.

get.summary: Get a public key by ID (used by Discovery Nodes to verify teaser signatures)

200.description: The PEM public key for signature verification.

post.summary: Rotate publisher keys: generate a new key and revoke all previous ones

200.description: The new active key and the overlap deadline for prior keys.

get.summary: List published content with filters and pagination
get.description: Returns published content for the organization. Filter by content type, locale, and select specific fields.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response (e.g., "headline,description,media")

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor for cursor-based pagination. Pass the nextCursor from a previous response to get the next page. When provided, page parameter is ignored.

200.description: A page of published content. With `?cursor=` the `meta` block is cursor-based instead: `{ limit, hasMore, nextCursor }`.

get.summary: Get published content by UUID

200.description: The published content item.

get.summary: Get published content by content type and slug
get.description: Lookup content by its human-readable slug within a content type. Optionally specify locale.

200.description: The published content item for this content type + slug + locale.

get.summary: List all available content types with their schemas

200.description: The organization's content types, ordered by ID.

get.summary: Get content type by ID with full schema

200.description: The content type including its form schema.

get.summary: List assets with optional mime type filter

200.description: Offset-paginated asset page. Pagination lives inside `data` (`items`/`total`/`limit`/`offset`), not in a `meta` block.

get.summary: Get asset metadata by UUID

200.description: Public asset metadata.

get.summary: List available layouts for a content type

200.description: Active layouts of the content type in sort order, without the (large) `definition` document.

get.summary: Get full layout definition

200.description: The complete layout row including its `layout/v1` definition document.
